remarks: Move right into this beautifully remodeled 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo located in a quiet, well-maintained complex in Norwalk! Perfectly suited for commuters and city lovers alike, this one-level unit offers low-maintenance living just minutes from South Norwalk (SoNo) with its vibrant dining, shopping, and waterfront attractions. Enjoy brand-new flooring throughout, a stylishly renovated kitchen with modern finishes, a refreshed bathroom, and newer windows that fill the space with natural light. Everything has been done for you-just unpack and relax! Whether you're a first-time buyer, downsizer, or savvy investor, this turnkey condo offers incredible value and convenience. Easy access to major highways and public transportation makes getting around a breeze. Don't miss this opportunity to live near the action while enjoying peace and privacy at home! HOA Fees include: Natural Gas Heat, Hot Water, Insurance, Trash Removal and All-Season Ground Maintenance.
